description: The user's review queue and mode: summaries, suggestions, imports, clean-ups, deletes, conflicts. list (a line each; item_id: one in full), get_mode: read-only. walk: items waiting, as boxes or links. approve: make it a record (edit / move_to first), delete (confirm_name), or confirm a conflict (keep=a|b|both). set_mode: which new records wait. approve, reject and set_mode require a user_request quoting the user; on Hosted, approve and reject are refused for AI clients, and the user decides them on their FlowState review page. Returns {items, total}, the mode, or the result.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

after.description: list, walk: the page after this id.

component.description: approve: component to file it under.

item_id.description: list: one in full. approve / reject: its id.

model.description: Model name if known. Unknown names are omitted.

move_to.description: Project to move a misfiled item to.

priority.description: approve: for a todo or problem.

name: manage_review
